name: v1.4.0
body:
Desktop GUI for the official Proton Drive CLI. Not affiliated with Proton AG.

### What's new
- **Folder colours.** Right-click a folder in My files → Folder colour, pick one of eight colours or Default. The colour shows in the list, the grid and the sidebar tree. Colours are kept only on your computer (the CLI can't set them), so they don't appear in the web app or on other devices.
- **Right-click on empty space** in My files: New folder, New file and Paste.
- **Copy, Cut and Paste** for files and folders: right-click, or Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V. The clipboard is internal to the app. A pasted copy that clashes with an existing name gets " (copy)".
- **.deb packages** for Debian, Ubuntu and Linux Mint (amd64 and arm64), next to the AppImages. `sudo apt install ./protondrive-gui_<version>_<arch>.deb` installs the app and the system libraries it needs. The official `proton-drive` CLI is not included and still has to be installed separately.

### Fixes
- The My files arrow in the sidebar now sits inside the highlight, on both themes.
- Menu icons and colour swatches have a little space from the highlight edge, and the expanded-folder arrow in the tree no longer sticks out of the selection.
- The My files label stays readable when a folder in the tree is selected.
- Pointing-hand cursor on the folder arrow and sidebar buttons.

### Known limitations
- Linux only.
- Account storage quota isn't shown; the CLI doesn't expose it.
- No thumbnails in Photos; the CLI only offers full-file downloads.
- Proton's own documents and sheets can't be downloaded through the CLI, so the app skips them and tells you.
- Share and sharing management are not implemented yet.
- The .deb has no apt repository, so it doesn't update through `apt upgrade`; install the newer file yourself.
- The .deb is built on Ubuntu 22.04 and needs a system at least that recent (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Linux Mint 21 or newer).

### Install
- Debian, Ubuntu, Mint: download the `.deb` from Assets below.
- Any Linux: download `ProtonDriveGUI-x86_64.AppImage` (or `aarch64`).
- From source: see the README; `./install.sh` sets up the CLI, dependencies and launcher.

The official `proton-drive` CLI is still required at runtime.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/al3xg0r/protondrive-gui/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0

name: v1.3.0
body:
Unofficial desktop GUI for the official Proton Drive CLI. Not affiliated with Proton AG.

### What's new
- **Folder tree in the sidebar.** Click the arrow next to My files to see your folders. Expand any folder to load its subfolders, click one to open it. Arrows appear only on folders that have subfolders. The selected folder is highlighted, and the scrollbar shows only while the pointer is over the tree.
- **Instant folder listings.** Folders you've opened before appear at once from a local cache, and the live listing replaces them a moment later. The cache is cleared on logout and is only readable by you. See the README for details.
- **List or grid view is remembered** across launches.
- **Account email** shown at the right of the top toolbar.

### Fixes
- Sidebar keeps its width after switching themes.
- Icons are drawn in the colour of the theme you chose, even when it differs from your desktop's theme. Previously a light theme on a dark desktop could give pale icons at startup.
- Icon strokes are a little heavier, so line icons are easier to see on light backgrounds.
- Selected folder band is taller, with even padding, and no second highlight appears when hovering it.

### Known limitations
- Linux only.
- Account storage quota isn't shown; the CLI doesn't expose it.
- No thumbnails in Photos; the CLI only offers full-file downloads.
- Proton's own documents and sheets can't be downloaded through the CLI, so the app skips them and tells you.
- Share, sharing management and multi-select are not implemented yet.
- Changes made from another device or the web app appear after the live listing loads.
- The update check in About makes one request to GitHub, only when About is opened.

### Install
- AppImage: download `ProtonDriveGUI-x86_64.AppImage` (or `aarch64`) from Assets below.
- Source: see the README; `./install.sh` sets up the CLI, dependencies and launcher.

The official `proton-drive` CLI is still required at runtime.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/al3xg0r/protondrive-gui/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0

name: v1.2.0
body:
Unofficial desktop GUI for the official Proton Drive CLI. Not affiliated with Proton AG.

### What's new
- **Folder sizes in the Size column.** They're counted in the background, remembered between launches, and refreshed after an hour or right after a change in the app. Information… for a folder shows the total size and item count.
- **Right-click menu like the web app:** Download, Move to folder (with a folder picker), Make a copy, Rename, Information, Move to Trash. Share is shown as "coming soon".
- **Better error reporting:** if the CLI skips an item (for example Proton's own sheets, which it can't download), you get a list of what was skipped instead of a silent result.
- **About dialog:** shows the GUI version and the CLI version, with an update status for each. If a newer CLI or GUI is out, it links to the download. 
- **Cleaner selection:** clicking empty space clears the selection and the focus outline.
- Right-click → Information is available everywhere, including Photos and Shared.

### Changes since v1.1.0
- Light/dark theme and grid view keep their state across a theme switch.
- Email in the top toolbar, with the grid spacing fixed.
- Clearer English labels in menus and dialogs.

### Known limitations
- Linux only.
- Account storage quota isn't shown; the CLI doesn't expose it.
- No thumbnails in Photos; the CLI only offers full-file downloads.
- Proton's own documents and sheets can't be downloaded through the CLI, so the app skips them and tells you.
- Share, sharing management and multi-select are not implemented yet.
- The update check makes one request to GitHub, only when About is opened.

### Install
- AppImage: download `ProtonDriveGUI-x86_64.AppImage` (or `aarch64`) from Assets below.

name: v1.1.0
body:
Unofficial desktop GUI for the official Proton Drive CLI. Not affiliated with Proton AG.

### What's new
- **Remembers where you were** — relaunching reopens the last section and folder you were in, and restores the window size and position.
- **Signed-in account shown** — your Proton email appears at the right of the top toolbar, next to Upload/Download. It's taken from the file listing, so no extra CLI call is needed.
- **Grid view fixes** — tiles now have proper space from the top edge and between rows, so the grid no longer looks cramped.
- **Grid view survives a theme switch** — toggling light/dark no longer drops you back to the list view.
- **Empty Trash stays with the left-side actions**, and only shows while you're in Trash.

### License change
This release moves from MIT to **PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0**. You can use, modify, and share the software for any noncommercial purpose, but commercial use and resale aren't allowed, and redistributions must keep the notice pointing back to this repository. See `LICENSE` for the exact terms.

### Known limitations
- Linux only.
- Account storage quota and folder sizes aren't shown; the CLI doesn't expose them.
- No real image thumbnails in Photos; the CLI only offers full-file downloads.
- The progress bar parses the CLI's terminal output, which isn't a documented format, so it may stop updating after a CLI update.
- Shared by me / Shared with me are browsed by analogy with My files and only lightly tested.

### Install
- AppImage: download `ProtonDriveGUI-x86_64.AppImage` (or `aarch64` for ARM) from the Assets below.
- Source: see the README; `./install.sh` sets up the CLI, dependencies, and launcher.

The official `proton-drive` CLI is still required at runtime.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/al3xg0r/protondrive-gui/compare/v1.0.3...v1.1.0

name: v1.0.3
body:
## Fixes
- AppImage: bundle the Qt `xcb` helper libraries (`libxcb-cursor`, `libxcb-icccm`, `libxcb-image`, `libxcb-keysyms`, `libxcb-render-util`, `libxcb-shape`, `libxcb-xkb`, `libxkbcommon-x11`). The app now starts on minimal systems that don't have them installed.
- AppImage: `AppRun` now also searches `usr/bin/_internal` for libraries.
- CI: the build script is now run via `bash`, so the build no longer fails with "Permission denied".

## Notes
- The official `proton-drive` CLI is still required on `PATH` at runtime; it is not bundled.

## Usage
    chmod +x ProtonDriveGUI-x86_64.AppImage
    ./ProtonDriveGUI-x86_64.AppImage

name: v1.0.0
body:
Unofficial desktop GUI wrapper around the official [Proton Drive CLI](https://proton.me/support/drive-cli). Not affiliated with Proton AG.

First non-beta release — the core file-management workflow (browse, upload, download, organize, trash) has been through several rounds of testing against a real account since the first beta. Still actively developed; see the README's Roadmap for what's next and the "What the CLI can and can't do" section for known limitations.

### Highlights
- Browse My files, Photos, Trash, Shared by me, Shared with me from a left sidebar with the current section highlighted
- List and grid views, both with color-coded icons by file type (folders, photos, videos, spreadsheets, archives, audio, generic files) — Proton's own native Docs/Sheets formats are recognized too, not just file extensions
- Upload/download with a live progress bar; drag & drop (including whole folders in My files)
- New folder, rename, move-to-Trash, restore, permanent delete, empty Trash
- Right-click → Properties for a quick look at any item's details
- Breadcrumb navigation, a "Go to path…" shortcut for sections without a sidebar button
- One-shot installer (`./install.sh`) and AppImage packaging (`./build-appimage.sh`) — Flatpak and Snap intentionally not offered
- Desktop launcher, styled menus/dialogs, dark-theme support

### Known limitations
- Linux only
- No account name or storage quota shown (not exposed by the CLI as of Sep 2026 — confirmed against their latest docs)
- No real image/video thumbnails in the Photos grid (technically possible only via full-file download, deliberately not done automatically)
- Shared by me / Shared with me browsing is implemented by analogy with My files and only lightly tested against real shared content
- Progress bar parses undocumented CLI terminal output — may break on a future `proton-drive` update
- Delete/rename not available in Photos or Shared views

### Requirements
- Linux, Python 3.10+
- The official [Proton Drive CLI](https://proton.me/drive/download) — `./install.sh` handles this for you

Bug reports and PRs welcome — see the README for setup, the full feature list, and the roadmap.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/al3xg0r/protondrive-gui/compare/v0.1.0b1...v1.0.0

name: v0.1.0b4 — fourth beta
body:
Unofficial desktop GUI wrapper around the official [Proton Drive CLI](https://proton.me/support/drive-cli). Not affiliated with Proton AG.

### ✨ What's new
- **Grid view overhaul** — real fixed grid layout (was ragged/uneven before), color-coded icons (amber folders, blue photos, red videos, grey files) drawn at full size instead of upscaled from small icons, filenames elided to keep the extension visible, card-style tiles
- **Photos: real filenames and sizes** — `photo timeline -d` exposes real names/sizes/media type, so Photos no longer shows bare capture-time placeholders; videos get a distinct icon from photos
- **Folder drag & drop** — confirmed against the official CLI docs that `filesystem upload` accepts folders directly; drag & drop in My files now supports whole folders, not just individual files
- **Simplified navigation** — removed the always-visible Path bar in favor of a compact "Go to path…" button next to the breadcrumbs, for the cases (like `/devices`) with no sidebar shortcut
- **Human-readable timestamps** — dates now show as `2026-07-02 19:26:54` in your local time zone, instead of raw UTC ISO 8601 (`2026-07-02T19:26:54.000Z`)
- **New app icon** — a cloud with an upload arrow, replacing the earlier folder-and-padlock design
- **License** — MIT plus a requirement that forks/redistributions keep a visible link back to this repository

### ⚠️ Known limitations
- Linux only
- No account name or storage quota shown (the CLI doesn't expose them)
- No real image/video thumbnails in the Photos grid — confirmed impossible without a full-file download; the CLI only generates thumbnails on upload for the official apps' own use
- Progress bar and Photos download rely on undocumented CLI behavior — may break on a future `proton-drive` update
- Delete/rename/restore not available in the Photos or Shared views
- No folder-sync feature yet (postponed — see Roadmap)

### 📋 Requirements
- Linux, Python 3.10+
- The official [Proton Drive CLI](https://proton.me/drive/download) — `./install.sh` handles this for you

Bug reports and PRs welcome — see the README for setup and the current roadmap.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/al3xg0r/protondrive-gui/compare/v0.1.0b3...v0.1.0b4

name: v0.1.0b3 — third beta
body:
Unofficial desktop GUI wrapper around the official [Proton Drive CLI](https://proton.me/support/drive-cli). Not affiliated with Proton AG.

### ✨ What's new
- **Drag & drop upload** — drop files onto the window (folders not yet supported — drop the files inside them instead)
- **Trash support** — browse Trash like any other folder, restore items or permanently delete them (right-click), and Empty Trash entirely — both destructive actions confirm first
- **Breadcrumb trail** — always know where you are, click any segment to jump back
- **Toolbar no longer silently hides buttons** on narrow windows — falls back to icon-only mode instead of buttons vanishing with zero indication (a real bug found via testing, not just cosmetic)
- Empty Trash button only shows up while actually browsing Trash

### ⚠️ Known limitations

- No account name or storage quota shown (the CLI doesn't expose them)
- Drag & drop doesn't support whole folders yet
- Progress bar and Photos download rely on undocumented CLI behavior — may break on a future `proton-drive` update

name: v0.1.0b2 — second beta
body:
Unofficial desktop GUI wrapper around the official [Proton Drive CLI](https://proton.me/support/drive-cli). Not affiliated with Proton AG.

### ✨ What's new since v0.1.0b1
- **One-shot installer** (`./install.sh`) — fetches the official CLI directly from Proton's release index with SHA-512 checksum verification, installs system dependencies, sets up the Python environment, and installs the desktop launcher. Also auto-recovers from the "Illegal instruction" crash on older CPUs by falling back to the x64-baseline build.
- **Live upload/download progress bar** — best-effort, since the CLI has no `--json` progress format; parses its terminal spinner output via a pseudo-terminal (needed because the CLI stays silent over a plain pipe).
- **New folder, rename, move-to-Trash** (right-click a row) — My files only for now.
- Fixed a crash/hang after login-logout caused by a PySide6 worker-thread reference-lifetime bug.
- Custom palette-aware monochrome icons (previously relied on the system icon theme, which was inconsistent/invisible on some themes).

### ✨ Carried over from v0.1.0b1
- Browse My files and Photos (Photos is a flat, most-recent-first timeline)
- Upload / download files and photos
- Log in / log out
- Desktop launcher

### ⚠️ Known limitations
- Linux only
- No account name or storage quota shown (the CLI doesn't expose them)
- No permanent delete yet — only move-to-Trash
- No drag & drop
- Progress bar and Photos download rely on undocumented CLI behavior — may break on a future `proton-drive` update
- Delete/rename/new folder not available in the Photos view

### 📋 Requirements
- Linux, Python 3.10+
- The official [Proton Drive CLI](https://proton.me/drive/download) — `./install.sh` handles this for you

Bug reports and PRs welcome — see the README for setup and the current roadmap.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/al3xg0r/protondrive-gui/compare/v0.1.0b1...v0.1.0b2

name: v0.1.0b1 — first beta
body:
Unofficial desktop GUI wrapper around the official [Proton Drive CLI](https://proton.me/support/drive-cli). Not affiliated with Proton AG.

### ✨ What works
- Browse **My files** (folders, double-click to open, Back button)
- Separate **Photos** view — flat, most-recent-first timeline (Proton's CLI exposes photos differently from regular files: no folders, no file size)
- Upload / download files (and photos)
- **New folder**, **Rename**, **Move to Trash** (right-click a row) — My files only for now
- Log in / log out
- Desktop launcher (`.desktop` entry) — no terminal needed after setup

### ⚠️ Known limitations
- Linux only, tested on one setup — your mileage may vary
- No account name or storage quota shown (the CLI doesn't expose them)
- No permanent delete yet — only move-to-Trash
- No upload/download progress bar
- No drag & drop
- Delete/rename/new folder not available in the Photos view

### 📋 Requirements
- Python 3.10+
- The official [Proton Drive CLI](https://proton.me/drive/download) installed and on your `PATH`

### 🐛 This is a beta
Built by reverse-engineering the CLI's `--json` output field-by-field against a real account, since Proton hasn't published a schema. Bug reports and PRs welcome — see the README for setup and the current roadmap.
